summary: This PR adds get/set_antialiased to Text objects, improving flexibility and consistency with other artists. However, it requires careful review of backend code and potential impact on existing behavior.

issues.description: Potential behavioral regression risk due to changes in backend code and GraphicsContext state.
Minor style inconsistency in using both `self._antialiased` and `mpl.rcParams['text.antialiased']`.
No additional tests for the change, although automated tests already pass.
The approach requires understanding of backend code and may be brittle or hard to maintain.
Potential API break if the change affects existing usage of `rcParams['text.antialiased']`.
